van_grid.method: obstacles (houses minus arch openings, garages, shop, kiosks, booths, box fence with the wicket, playgrounds, trash sections, palisades, cars, lamps, pull-up bars, fences) on a 0.25 m grid; district ground + roads allowed; widest path from the south road, value = widest corridor (m) on the best path, tested at 2.3 / 2.6 / 3.0 / 3.5 / 4.0 / 5.0 / 6.0 m

van_sweep.method: EDT of the obstacle raster sampled over the 2.3 x 5.5 m rectangle every 0.25 m along the path (corners filleted with r <= 6 m); tracks trimmed by half a van at both ends; per arch: van inside the arch + best of straight / left / right 90-degree exit at each mouth; value = clearance to the nearest obstacle (0 = touching)

min_gaps_m.note: axis gap between solids of different houses / groups (0 = touching)

entrances.rule: on the host facade line (<= 5 cm), >= 1.5 m from its ends, on a LONG side (R2c rollout puts entrance kits there only), path not into another part / arch / booth

edges_m.note: distance from the district edge (fence / outer road axis) to the first houses; must equal v52 (Fedya 22.10 item 3)

density.note: khrushchevka houses only (13 houses); gap = axis gap between a house and the nearest other house
